title: Keep plain Git worktrees when the host neither removes nor owns its checkouts

rubric.text: Rejects the managed worktree and creates a plain Git worktree with `git worktree add -b <task-branch> <path> <integrated-sha>`, because the host neither removes its managed checkouts nor forbids shell-created ones and owns their cleanup; verifies the branch and HEAD before work starts

Does not plan a host-cleanup handoff; retires the delivered checkout with `git worktree remove --force <path>` once after the status and artifact checks, verified absent in `git worktree list --porcelain`
Does not ask the user for a cleanup exception or treat cleanup as unavailable
Provides a read-only assessment and does not create checkouts, start owners or mutate files
